remarks:
Welcome to 55 Groton Drive, Unit C, where comfort, convenience, and a peaceful setting come together to create the perfect place to call home! Nestled within a serene and private community, this beautifully updated walk-up condo offers a refreshing escape from the everyday hustle while providing all the benefits of low-maintenance living.

Step inside and discover a warm, inviting interior featuring updated flooring throughout, a beautifully refreshed kitchen, and tastefully updated bathrooms. The impressive finished basement adds an entirely new dimension to the home, offering versatile additional space perfect for entertaining, a home office, recreation room, or simply relaxing.

But the lifestyle doesn't stop at your front door! Enjoy access to fantastic community amenities, including a clubhouse, sparkling in-ground pool, and tennis courts, bringing recreation and relaxation right to your neighborhood.

With thoughtful updates, exceptional amenities, and a peaceful setting that feels like your own private retreat, 55 Groton Drive, Unit C offers so much more than just a place to live. **It's an opportunity to enjoy the lifestyle you've been looking for!
